summary_1line: The Pandavas journey toward Gandhamadana seeking Arjuna, hear sacred lore of the Ganga and Mandara, and Lomasa recounts Vishnu slaying Naraka and raising the Earth as a boar.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandavas stand before the celestial river Alakananda flowing from the heights as sages and Gandharvas chant hymns around its shining waters.
A vast white mound of bones of the slain Daitya Naraka lies piled like a mountain before the astonished Pandavas.
Vishnu in the form of a colossal boar with blazing red eyes lifts the sinking Earth upon a single radiant tusk while the heavens tremble and the gods watch in awe.
